name: com.cielevel.axu-unity-cli-kit
description: Package-level documentation plus agent skills for driving Unity from a terminal: the unity CLI, the com.unity.pipeline live-Editor API, CI build/test recipes and troubleshooting. Ships an Editor installer that materializes the skill into this project's AI-client folders (.claude, .zcode, .agents, .cursor, .windsurf, .clinerules, .github, AGENTS.md) and can pull the official Unity skills on demand.

samples.description: Workflow that installs the unity CLI, runs EditMode/PlayMode tests with a JUnit report and uploads it as a GitHub check.
Drop-in AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md block that points any agent at the installed skill and states the live-Editor-first rule.
A minimal skill folder (SKILL.md + references/) to copy when adding your own project skill to this package.
